description: This file contains Perl scripts implementing elliptic curve cryptography operations for the P-256 curve on ARMv8 architecture, including multiplication, squaring, addition, subtraction, point doubling, point addition, and lookup functions, with embedded assembly code for performance.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_mul_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication of two 256-bit numbers for elliptic curve operations.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_sqr_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery squaring of a 256-bit number for elliptic curve operations.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_div_by_2
methods.description: Divides a 256-bit number by 2 in the Montgomery domain.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_neg
methods.description: Negates a 256-bit number in the elliptic curve field.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_add_affine
methods.description: Adds an affine elliptic curve point to a projective point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_ord_mul_mont
methods.description: Multiplies two 256-bit numbers modulo the curve order in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_ord_sqr_mont
methods.description: Squares a 256-bit number modulo the curve order in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_select_w5
methods.description: Selects a 256-bit value from a table based on index, for w5 (5-word) lookup.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_select_w7
methods.description: Selects a 256-bit value from a table based on index, for w7 (7-word) lookup.
